card.who: The night watchman on the warehouse row. He has a hut and a brazier on the quay and walks the row on the hour.
card.speak: Nervous, mumbling, says "I couldn't say" a great deal.
card.life: Ex-docker, kept on as watchman when the rest went. Terry Hodgson brings him a paper at night.
card.fire: He was the watchman the night No. 4 burned. He says he was at the far end, by No. 1, and saw the glow.
card.rivals: He is paid by the company that owns the row. The cheque is signed by Agar's office.
card.secret: He saw one of Mickey's cars pull away from No. 4 with its lights off, and he had been told to be at the far end.
